subject.title: refactor(ui): direct enable/disable and remove actions on plugin cards

question: Should MCP server rows retain immediate one-click removal when the remove action is promoted from an overflow menu to an exposed trash button?
rationale: Tests and screenshots can prove the control works, but they cannot determine the intended safety threshold for a newly exposed destructive action.

options.title: Confirm MCP removal
options.body: Use the existing inline-confirm pattern, or an equivalent confirmation, before deleting an MCP server from its row.

options.title: Accept immediate removal
options.body: Keep the single-click trash action and explicitly accept the increased accidental-activation risk as the intended UX.

recommendation.title: Confirm MCP removal
recommendation.body: Use the existing inline-confirm pattern, or an equivalent confirmation, before deleting an MCP server from its row.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history in the adjacent Control UI surface and can resolve the interaction-policy intent.
